name: Vicky
source:
Daughter of a wealthy family, and under the watchful eye of her controlling mother, Vicky aches to escape the privileged prison she is trapped within.

Her beauty is a curse. Her mother pushes her to become a star, when all she wants to do is run away.

Vicky is searching for an escape, even if that escape means delving to deep into family secrets.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Vicky]DumbKoala[/url]]
